users: The board's owner, one experienced developer who keeps the app open all day while many coding agents run
primary_task: Get the board connected and accounts signed in, then check and adjust work hours and usage limits so agents keep working when they should

units.name: Settings shell
units.scope: The Settings window frame: sidebar, section switching, page header, window sizes, keyboard use, focus, closing, and the loading, failed, connecting and board-stopped states shared by every section. Rules that hold here: the window is the owner's only way to set these things; the app is otherwise read-only apart from one-click signals; one home per object; no filler labels; 12-hour times with AM/PM; long lists virtualized. A proposal that breaks a rule is allowed if marked 'needs the owner's OK'. Say for each finding whether it is Confirmed (seen in a capture or the code) or Likely. Give a concrete fix for every finding rated 2 or higher. The Settings window runs 720x460 minimum, 900x680 default. Captures named down-* have the board stopped; acct-*, pill-*, usage-daily and usage-lifted come from a stand-in board with made-up data, so their numbers and wording of reasons are not the product's. The 'Sample' pill only shows on the sample board. The code files are excerpts; each first line names the source file and lines.
